page.overview:
What is Zhalfir?

Zhalfir (zhal-FEER) was a more than five thousand-year-old militaristic kingdom on Dominaria. It was located along the western plains, forests, and coasts of Jamuraa. After being phased out, its former location is now known as the Zhalfirin Void. It became a plane of its own in the aftermath of New Phyrexia's Invasion of the Multiverse.

Zhalfir made up the northwestern coast of Jamuraa's western continent. Its coastal sands give way to a dune forest, eventually leading to scrubland dominated by low, wide-canopied trees.

While phased out of Dominaria, it had no moons. Now, it is orbited by the former suns of Mirrodin.

The kingdom is ruled by a monarch, currently, Queen Wezna, who is advised by the kingdom's general, currently Mageta, and a council of five high wizards, one from each of Zhalfir's Creeds.
